# Heidi Blondin Financial

- Heidi Blondin Financial is a financial services firm based in Kingston, Ontario, offering financial planning, life and living benefits insurance, mutual funds, socially responsible investing, and client education workshops. The firm serves professional families, women, and individuals navigating key life transitions. Content produced for this firm must comply with Investia Financial Services Inc. regulatory and compliance requirements.

- Heidi Blondin Financial is led by founder Heidi Blondin, BA, CFP®, EPC (Certified Financial Planner and Elder Planning Counsellor). Heidi's approach centres on financial education and empowerment: helping clients understand their options so they can make informed decisions. Mutual funds and investments are provided through Investia Financial Services Inc. All marketing content is subject to Investia compliance review prior to publication.

## Services

- [Financial Planning](https://heidiblondin.com/what-is-a-financial-planner/): One-on-one holistic planning to align money with life goals, retirement, and major transitions.
- [Life Insurance and Living Benefits](https://heidiblondin.com/life-insurance-isnt-something-set-forget/): Guidance on term and permanent life insurance, critical illness, and disability coverage for individuals and families.
- [Socially Responsible Investing](https://heidiblondin.com/socially-responsible-investing/): Investment approach focused on ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) principles.
- [Retirement Income Planning](https://heidiblondin.com/much-need-save-retirement/): Strategies for building and drawing on retirement income, including CPP timing, RRSP/RRIF, and TFSA.
- [Legacy and Estate Planning](https://heidiblondin.com/resources/): Guidance on wills, powers of attorney, beneficiary designations, and executor preparation.

## Savings and Investment Accounts

- [Tax-Free Savings Account (TFSA)](https://heidiblondin.com/tax-free-savings-account/): How TFSAs work, contribution rules, and tax-free growth strategies.
- [TFSA and RRIF Legislative Updates](https://heidiblondin.com/proposed-changes-tfsa-limits-minimum-rif-withdrawal-rates/): Insights on changes to TFSA limits and minimum RRIF withdrawal rates.
- [Retirement Savings Strategies](https://heidiblondin.com/much-need-save-retirement/): RRSP vs. TFSA, retirement income sequencing, and saving timelines.
- [Savings Strategies](https://heidiblondin.com/savings-strategies/): General savings frameworks for different life stages.


## Resources

- [Client Resources](https://heidiblondin.com/resources/): Financial planning tools, checklists, and educational videos including legacy planning guides.
- [Blog](https://heidiblondin.com/blog/): Articles on retirement planning, insurance, TFSA, budgeting, and financial literacy.

## Blog: Key Articles

- [How Much Do I Need to Save for Retirement?](https://heidiblondin.com/much-need-save-retirement/): Retirement savings questions answered, including RRSP vs. TFSA strategy and CPP timing.
- [Baby Steps to Protect Your Family](https://heidiblondin.com/baby-steps-protect-family/): Introduction to life insurance and family financial protection.
- [Life Insurance Isn't Set It and Forget It](https://heidiblondin.com/life-insurance-isnt-something-set-forget/): Why insurance policies need regular review as life circumstances change.
- [Mortgage Protection: Not the Best Option](https://heidiblondin.com/mortgage-protection-not-best-option/): Why bank mortgage insurance is often inferior to personally owned life insurance.
- [Budgeting Can Be Fun](https://heidiblondin.com/budgeting-can-fun/): Practical, approachable budgeting guidance.
- [Gift Ideas for Children and Grandchildren](https://heidiblondin.com/gift-ideas-children-grandchildren/): Financial gifts and savings strategies for the next generation.

## Team

- [Heidi Blondin, BA, CFP®, EPC](https://heidiblondin.com/about/): Founder and lead advisor. Certified Financial Planner and Elder Planning Counsellor with a focus on financial education, women's financial empowerment, and holistic planning.
- [Heidi's Team](https://heidiblondin.com/about/): Heidi's team is here to help with financial planning and supporting client care and planning services.

## Compliance Notice

- Heidi Blondin Financial operates under Investia Financial Services Inc. (a member of iA Financial Group). All investment and insurance content is subject to Investia compliance review. Marketing materials must not contain unsubstantiated performance claims, must clearly label any hypothetical illustrations, and must fairly present product risks. Content referencing specific financial products or investment returns requires appropriate disclaimers.
